args.title: Fix issue 4410 in src/config.ts
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The setting TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES is parsed as an integer number of minutes in src/config.ts using the int() function, which does not accept a value like '12h'. Instead, it reads the invalid string as NaN and falls back to 12 due to parsing. The fix is to check that the value is numeric and reject or correctly parse duration strings, so an input like '12h' does not silently become 12.

args.title: Fix issue 4423 in src/i18n/index.ts
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The function pickLocale parses the Accept-Language header by splitting on commas and then taking the first two characters of each language subtag to find a supported locale. It ignores the quality values (q=) and simply returns the first supported locale found. This causes it to ignore the q= priorities and always pick the first listed supported language, which explains why French with higher weight returns English if English appears first. To fix this, pickLocale should parse and respect the q= values to choose the supported locale with the highest quality value.
